correctness.rationale: On a finite chain, downward confluence is equivalent to nondecreasing row minima and forward confluence to nondecreasing row maxima; each converse uses the endpoint itself as the existential witness. Together they force either an empty relation or all rows nonempty. Fixed finite endpoints then constrain each row only by mandatory endpoints and optional interior cells, proving the exact weighted sum. Direct exhaustive checking through n=4 and an independent dynamic program agree.
